audit: Independent local mechanical repair candidate r33 package audit
method: Read the two specified evidence inventories, author/quick_validate.py, and only the 36 explicit paths in each package.
Compare raw bytes without newline normalization; compute byte counts, SHA-256, and Git blob SHA-1 using SHA1("blob " + ASCII byte count + NUL + bytes).
Compute complete line-level differences for the three expected changed files and record exact before/after text, line ranges, byte spans, and hashes.

Verify root metadata.version plus one navigation paragraph extension, one execution-protocol navigation paragraph replacement, and profile protocol_revision only; forward and inverse substitutions must reproduce the complete counterpart bytes.
Resolve all 34 inventoried bundled SHA-256 declarations at their source JSON pointers and compare them with freshly calculated target bytes.
Scan all three changed files for full SHA-256 and SHA-1 literals; reconcile SHA-256 occurrence counts to declared bundled/excluded inventory and check for old hashes of changed targets.
Run author/quick_validate.py as a subprocess against the separate repair candidate.

exact_changed_scope.scope: root metadata.version replacement plus one existing general navigation paragraph extension
exact_changed_scope.extension_text: When fragment destinations follow images, reserve each image's intrinsic aspect geometry using markup supported by the destination, such as an img element with the exported width and height. Verify that an unloaded image already occupies the correct proportional box and remains undistorted after loading. Check a first-use help-to-main route to a later target before warming the main page or its image URLs, as well as ordinary already-visited forward and return routes. Preserve an observed first-use miss; a successful repeat does not establish that the first-use path works. A controlled diagnostic must keep unrelated text, mathematics, targets and image bytes fixed while varying the suspected layout feature, and distinguish demonstrated cause from remaining timing or cache uncertainty.

changes.current_text: For linked GitHub teaching files, give anchors document-specific names so corresponding prompts, hints and solutions do not reuse the same fragment across sibling files. Check actual forward and return clicks after the destination has settled, including a later target reached from an already-fragmented URL. Verify that the intended content is visible, not merely that the URL and anchor exist. Preserve a failed route and follow the active repair mode; see execution-protocol.md for the destination check.

exact_changed_scope.scope: one existing general navigation paragraph replacement

changes.current_text: For linked teaching/help, inventory the source and target file and fragment for each route. In GitHub Markdown, use distinct document-specific anchor names across sibling files. Exercise ordinary forward and return clicks, including later targets below the initial viewport and successive cross-file navigation from a URL that already has a fragment. After the article and rendering settle, observe the matching target in the viewport; a correct href, preserved anchor, loaded file or manually opened deep URL does not establish the click route. Separate transient load states and screenshot-induced scrolling from a reproducible settled failure. If an alternative is needed, verify it in a separate bounded destination fixture before using it, and recheck the whole final artifact. Reopen earlier acceptance only where inspection establishes the demonstrated dependency; syntax presence alone is not a browser failure.
changes.candidate_text: For linked teaching/help, inventory the source and target file and fragment for each route. In GitHub Markdown, use distinct document-specific anchor names across sibling files. Where images precede a fragment target, reserve their exported aspect ratio with destination-supported width/height markup and inspect the unloaded as well as loaded image boxes. Exercise a first-use route from help to a later main target before visiting that main page or its image URLs; then check ordinary already-visited forward and return clicks, including successive cross-file navigation from an already-fragmented URL. Record cache conditions that cannot be controlled. After the article and rendering settle, observe the matching target in the viewport; a correct href, preserved anchor, loaded file or manually opened deep URL does not establish the click route. Do not scroll or take a full-page capture between the tested click and its settled observation. Separate transient load states and screenshot-induced scrolling from an actual settled failure, and retain a first-use miss even when repeats pass. If collapsed unloaded image boxes expand and move the target out of view, test intrinsic geometry reservation in a bounded fixture with otherwise identical text, mathematics, targets and image bytes. Verify the alternative on the actual destination before using it, then recheck the whole final artifact including image proportions and first-use routes. Reopen earlier acceptance where the same dependency and an actual failed route are evidenced; a markup census alone inventories exposure and is not a browser failure.

quick_validate.coverage: Minimal SKILL.md YAML frontmatter/name/description validation as implemented by author/quick_validate.py.

limits: Local mechanical byte-integrity and minimal frontmatter validation only; no teaching, scientific-content, learner, or behavioral evaluation was performed.
Only the named inventories, validator, and 36 explicit files under each named package root were read for this repair audit; no separate teaching/source/reports/history directories were accessed.
No directory enumeration was performed, so absence of extra unlisted files was not independently asserted.

The supplied internal-hashes.json defines the 34 bundled declarations and their target resolution; the independent changed-file literal scan found no unclassified hashes there, but no whole-package declaration census was repeated.
The 31 external/historical nonbundled declarations recorded by the inventory were not fetched or revalidated.
Current identities were compared with expected identities carried by internal-hashes.json; its original inputs manifest was not opened.
No GitHub, browser, remote publication, repository history, live installed skill, external source, or access-control verification was performed.
The previous metadata-only candidate was not used or modified. Neither package nor publication was mutated; this audit writes only evidence/repair-package-check.json.
audit_implementation_note: The initial scope predicate assumed an LF root version-line terminator; it was corrected to accept the observed unchanged CRLF terminator. All exact forward/inverse raw-byte comparisons were rechecked, and all 72 package-file SHA-256 identities remained equal to the audited snapshots.
